Title: Hand-Poured Lavender Candle
Body (HTML):
A beautifully hand-poured lavender soy candle that fills your home with the most calming, gentle scent. Made in small batches with pure soy wax and essential oils, this candle burns cleanly for up to 40 hours.

Light it on a slow Sunday morning, let it flicker during a bath, or gift it to someone who deserves a little moment of peace. The soft cream vessel looks just as lovely unlit as it does glowing.

A perfect treat for yourself or a thoughtful gift for the home lover in your life.

Title: Vintage Floral Teacup Set
Body (HTML):
Delicate and utterly charming, this vintage-inspired floral teacup set is the kind of thing slow mornings are made of. Each cup is hand-finished with a gentle floral motif in soft pinks and greens.

Perfect for your morning tea ritual or as a display piece on an open shelf. The set includes two cups and saucers, gift-boxed and ready to delight.

Title: Woven Seagrass Basket
Body (HTML):
Handwoven from natural seagrass by skilled artisans, this beautiful basket brings warmth and texture to any room. Use it to store throws, magazines, toys, or simply as a decorative accent.

Its natural tones work with any interior. Sturdy yet lightweight, it's as practical as it is pretty.

Title: Linen Throw Pillow
Body (HTML):
Soft, breathable, and beautifully textured, this linen throw pillow adds an instant layer of warmth and style to any sofa or bed. Made from stonewashed linen in a gentle natural tone that works with everything.

The removable cover zips off for easy washing. The inner cushion pad is included.

Title: Dried Flower Bouquet
Body (HTML):
A gorgeous arrangement of dried wildflowers and botanicals, hand-tied and ready to display. Unlike fresh flowers, these beauties last for months — no water, no fuss, just everlasting charm.

Tuck them into a vase, hang them upside down as wall art, or prop them in a corner for that unmistakably cosy cottage feel.

Title: Artisan Ceramic Vase
Body (HTML):
Wheel-thrown and hand-finished by an independent ceramicist, this beautiful vase has the slight imperfections that make handmade pieces so special. Its organic shape and matte glaze catch the light in the most lovely way.

Display it alone on a windowsill, fill it with dried stems, or pair it with our Dried Flower Bouquet for a complete look.

Title: Chunky Knit Throw Blanket
Body (HTML):
Sink into this gloriously chunky knit throw and feel instantly at home. Made from a soft, weighty yarn in a classic cable-knit pattern, it drapes beautifully over a sofa arm or at the foot of a bed.

Large enough to really snuggle into. Available in a warm natural oatmeal tone.

Title: Soy Wax Candle Trio
Body (HTML):
Three beautifully scented soy wax candles in our most-loved fragrances: Warm Vanilla, Fresh Linen, and Autumn Walk. Each candle is hand-poured in small batches using 100% natural soy wax and cotton wicks.

Presented in a gift-ready kraft box tied with ribbon. Each candle burns for approximately 35 hours.

Title: Handmade Beeswax Candle
Body (HTML):
Pure natural beeswax, rolled by hand into a classic pillar candle. Beeswax candles burn longer and cleaner than paraffin, and release a gentle natural honey scent as they glow.

New to the collection and made in the UK by an independent candlemaker.

Title: Rustic Wooden Serving Board
Body (HTML):
Crafted from sustainably sourced oak, this generous serving board is as beautiful as it is functional. Use it for cheese and charcuterie, fresh bread, or simply as a display piece in the kitchen.

The natural grain of the wood makes every board unique. Oiled and ready to use straight from the box.

Title: Embroidered Cotton Napkins
Body (HTML):
Set of four cotton napkins, each hand-embroidered with a delicate botanical motif. Soft, absorbent, and generously sized — these are the napkins that turn an ordinary dinner into something special.

Machine washable at 40 degrees. Presented neatly folded in a tissue-lined box.

Title: Botanical Wall Art Print
Body (HTML):
A beautiful archival-quality art print featuring hand-drawn botanical illustrations in soft, natural tones. Printed on heavyweight 300gsm cotton rag paper for a gallery-quality finish.

Arrives rolled in a protective tube. Available unframed — the A3 size fits standard frames from most high street stores.

Title: Scented Reed Diffuser
Body (HTML):
A long-lasting reed diffuser in our signature Cosy Home fragrance — a warm blend of cedarwood, vanilla, and a hint of sandalwood. Simply insert the reeds and let the scent gently fill your room.

Each diffuser lasts approximately 8-10 weeks. New to the collection.

Title: Vintage Brass Picture Frame
Body (HTML):
A beautiful antique-style picture frame in warm brushed brass. The slightly aged finish gives it genuine vintage character that looks wonderful on a gallery wall or a mantelpiece.

Fits standard 5x7 inch photos. Freestanding with an easel back, or wall-mountable with the included hook.

Title: Handwoven Table Runner
Body (HTML):
An elegant handwoven table runner in a natural oatmeal and sage stripe. Made on a traditional loom from a soft cotton-linen blend that feels wonderful underhand and gets softer with every wash.

At 180cm long, it works on most dining tables. New in — a truly special piece.

Title: Ceramic Storage Jars Set
Body (HTML):
A set of three ceramic storage jars with cork lids, perfect for keeping your kitchen organised in style. Store coffee, sugar, tea, or grains — the airtight cork lids keep everything fresh.

The soft cream glaze with a hand-painted sprig detail makes these jars as beautiful as they are practical. Dishwasher safe (lids hand wash only).
